entities.name: Chatterfang
entities.description: A one-eyed black squirrel general who rallied the squirrels of the Umbra Forest against invading drakes.

entities.name: Ridgeback Mountains
entities.description: Mountains neighboring the Umbra Forest, home of the drakes.

entities.name: Orcfire Campaign
entities.description: Famous campaign in which Chatterfang was a veteran two summers earlier.

entities.name: Drakes
entities.description: Creatures from the Ridgeback Mountains that invaded the Umbra Forest in search of food.

events.summary: Drakes from the Ridgeback Mountains invaded the Umbra Forest, and Chatterfang rallied an army of squirrels to drive them back.
events.quote: rallied an army of fighting squirrels to drive the drakes back

events.summary: Chatterfang personally took down over a dozen drakes and wears their fangs as trophies.
events.quote: He personally took down over a dozen drakes on his own

relations.note: He fought and defeated the invading drakes.
relations.quote: He personally took down over a dozen drakes on his own
